learning_objective: 🎯 We will read a funny family story, learn new vocabulary words, and see how working together as a team makes solving problems fun and easy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Papa wants to read the newspaper but he cannot find his spectacles anywhere. He gets a little worried and starts looking all around the house.
When Papa asks for help, the whole family joins in! Everyone stops what they are doing to act like little detectives, searching under the sofa and behind the curtains.
After searching high and low, someone finally spots the missing glasses. They were resting right on top of Papa's head the whole time, making everyone laugh out loud!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Detective Hide and Seek
fun_activity.instructions: Hide a safe object like a small toy or a book somewhere in your room. Give your family members simple clues and see how fast they can find it!

quick_recap: ⭐ Papa lost his spectacles and needed his family's help to find them.
⭐ The whole family worked together as a great team to search the house.
⭐ It was very funny when they realized the glasses were on Papa's head all along!
